name: Android parity phone 402 x 874 dp

masks.name: status-bar
masks.why: Android's status bar (demo mode: 09:41, full battery, Wi-Fi, no notifications) replaces the design's drawn iOS one; the app draws edge to edge under it.

masks.name: gesture-handle
masks.why: Gesture navigation draws its handle over the app (screencap includes it) and the design render hides the home indicator. Content never sits here (the body keeps a 34 dp bottom inset, the 24 dp navigation inset included).

referenceSet: A new reference set for a new device: the Android parity emulator e07-android-parity, 402 x 874 dp at density 3.0 like the iPhone 16 Pro (owner default d), with Android's 24 dp status bar and gesture navigation. It is not a change to the iOS set in assets/reference, which stays byte for byte.
measured: Not measured on a device yet (E18-T07 created no AVD). The insets are the AOSP values for a 480 dpi screen without a cutout under gesture navigation (status bar 24 dp, navigation 24 dp); setup-parity-emu.mjs --check proves the size and density, and the first capture (E18-T20) proves the insets. A different measured inset is a deliberate profile change: the lead re-renders assets/reference-android with a referenceChanges entry.
